xln.text: Azor met Ugin at the Palace of Justice and devised a plan to get rid of Bolas, then traveled to Ixalan and sacrificed his spark to create the Immortal Sun, trapping himself there too.
The Sun was taken by Pedron the Wicked from its monastery, but Azor reclaimed it, and when the Sun Empire's emperor misused it, Azor made the Empire leave the hidden city of Orazca.

Jace and Vraska reached Azor in his sanctum in Orazca, where he revealed he never received Ugin's signal, and Jace stopped Vraska from killing him and, as the Living Guildpact, sentenced him to solitude on Useless Island.

rix.text: Azor greeted Vraska and Jace from his throne in Orazca, calling the Immortal Sun the lock of his prison and revealing that he gave up his spark to make it.
The plan, he explained, was to imprison Nicol Bolas, but he had waited in vain for Ugin's signal, left without a spark and a prisoner.

Azor attacked Vraska and Jace, and Jace judged him as Living Guildpact, sentencing him to be the caretaker of Useless Island, never to leave or meddle again, and Azor flew away, leaving the Immortal Sun.
